elements.name: two young men seen from behind
walking side by side into the lit street
taller young man in denim jacket
blue and white minibuses with headlights on

wrong_setting: The uniform Soviet-style concrete apartment towers read as Eastern Europe or Central Asia rather than Addis Ababa. The taller man looks light-skinned and non-Ethiopian. The figures stand in the middle of the road rather than at a bus stop.
notes: Turn the taller denim-jacket man so he is seen from behind, make him Ethiopian, and show both men walking into the street at a roadside bus stop. Soften the crowd into loose shapes, give the buildings an Addis Ababa character, and remove the bus logos, the license plates and the sign lettering on the right edge.
